Undesirable channels on DTH
Television
*261. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROAD-
CASTING  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that it has become
possible for the DTH  Television users to
view certain undesirable channels using
certain types of Smart Cards;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how  this misuse of the system is
proposed to be curtailed?
Oppression of downtrodden
†*262.SHRI  P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the incidents of oppressions of
downtrodden taking  place in the present

(b) if so, whether Government are
formulating any action plan to check such
incidents;
(c) whether Government propose to
constitute any monitoring agency in this
regard;
(d) if so,  details thereof; and
(e) if not, the effective measures being
taken by Government?
Reservation to SCs/STs and Physically
Handicapped
*263. SHRI GANDHI AZAD: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the ‘‘All India Association
for SCs/STs  and Physically Handicapped
Peoples Upliftment" has recently brought
to the notice of PMO the facts  about
reservation to SCs/STs  and Physically
Handicapped as per provision made in
1974 for  N.G.Os;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
action taken thereon; and

(c) if no action has been taken so far,
the reasons therefor and  by when, the
action will be taken on 1974 provision?
Special  package to boost exports
*264. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose
special packages  for boosting exports in
the textiles, tea and coffee industries as a
follow-up    to the Foreign Trade Policy;
(b) if so, whether Government have felt
a need for special emphasis on some sectors
in which the country had natural abilities;
(c) if so, the details of the packages
prepared in regard to tea and coffee; and
(d)  by when these are likely to be
announced and implemented?
Economic Cooperation with Pakistan
*265. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to implement the ‘‘Early Harvest Scheme
(EHS)’’ for economic cooperation  with
Pakistan;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether representatives of both the
countries have recently met to discuss the
possibilities of economic  cooperation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Recognition to small and regional
political parties
†*266. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a discussion has been held
recently to reconsider recognition of the
small and regional political parties and to
take an initiative to control  regionalism;
(b) if so, whether the Election
Commission  has suggested that it is
necessary to think over the recognition of
the political parties; and
(c) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
Delivery of degrees to students of Delhi
University
*267. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
several lakh students, who have passed out
from Delhi University during the last ten
years, have not been able to get their
degrees from the Delhi University because
of cumbersome rules adopted by the
University;
(b) if so, the number of degrees still
lying in the University;
(c) whether any efforts were made to
send those degrees to the students by post
and if so, with what result; and
(d) the steps being taken for the early
delivery of degree to the students?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Explosives in imported
metal scrap
@*268. SHRI LALIT SURI:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) the countries from where metal scrap
was allowed to be imported during 2004;
(b) whether the imported metal scrap
contained explosive  war-heads both used
and live that caused loss of life and property
as live war-heads exploded  at various
places in the country;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action taken/proposed  to be
taken to ensure that such dangerous imports
are banned?
Agreement with Gulf Cooperation
Council
*269. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Gulf Cooperation
Council (GCC)  have signed a framework
agreement on economic cooperation to give
fillip to the existing commercial and
economic  ties between the two countries;
(b) if so, whether his Ministry and the
Foreign Minister of Kuwait, who is the
Chairman of the GCC, signed an agreement
in this regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) to what extent India and Gulf
Cooperation Council have started
implementing this agreement?
Comprehensive action plan for urban
housing
*270. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA:
Will the Minister of URBAN
EMPLOYMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to formulate a comprehensive
action  plan to solve housing problems
faced by the urban poor and also those
living in the slums; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it would be implemented?
New Trade Policy
*271. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
declared the New Trade Policy;
(b) if so, whether farm sector has been
covered therein;
(c) if so,  the details  thereof;
(d) the sectors identified for
employment generation and export
promotion;
(e) whether Government have proposed
any new incentives for export oriented units
to boost the exports in 2005-06 and
2006-07; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Modernization of DD centres
†*272. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING  be pleased to state:
(a) the steps being taken by Government

Doordarshan centres;
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of the steps to be taken
in this regard in Bihar  during the Tenth
Five Year Plan period?
Functioning of Counselling and
De-addiction Centres
*273. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Counselling Centres
and De-addiction  Centres for alcoholics,
State-wise;
(b) whether the addiction cases  are on
the increase;
(c) the mechanism involved to review
the performance of these centres;
(d) whether there is any R&D on
problems of alcoholics; and
(e) the background for the policy
initiative to go for Counselling Centres
rather than  De-addiction Centres?
I.C.D.S. project-III
†*274. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) Government's plan to continue
operation of World Bank funded
I.C.D. S.-III project in Uttar Pradesh even
after June 30, 2004 alongwith the other
I.C.D.S. projects;
(b) Government's policy  to absorb the
personnel working under I.C.D.S.-III
project in the other projects;
(c) whether Government have received
any suggestions from Members of
Parliament in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken thereon so far?
Discretionary  Quota  of  Members  for
admissions  in Kendriya Vidyalayas
†*275. SHRI SURESH BHARDWAJ:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  Government are aware that
students have to face a lot of difficulties in
getting admission in Kendriya Vidyalayas
all over the country;
(b) whether  Government propose to
increase the discretionary quota for
Members of Parliament from 2 to 4

(c) if so, by when and if not, the reasons

Programmes to reduce
 poverty
†*276. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL:  Will the Minister of URBAN
EMPLOYMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION  be pleased  to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during the
Tenth Plan period a number  of
programmes are being implemented to
reduce proportion of poverty by 2007;
(b) if so,  the details thereof; and
(c) to what extent the reduction of
proportion of poverty is targeted during this
period and the targets achieved so far?

Education  after middle standard
†*277. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that after passing
out the 8th standard, every student is facing
difficulty in getting further education due
to  shortage of schools in the country;
(b) the average number of children
passing out 8th standard;
(c) the number of schools  upto 12th
standard as on March, 2004; and
(d) the extent of their capacity for
admission?
Demand of Engineers in Gulf
*278. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
Engineers are in great demand in Gulf
countries due to construction boom on
account of robust oil prices;
(b) if so, what would be the impact of
exodus of Indian engineers on the country's
economy and development; and
 (c) the steps being taken to safeguard
the national interest due to talent exodus?
Change in Patent Law
*279. DR. (SHRIMATI) NAJMA A.
HEPTULLA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to make changes in the present
Indian patent regime to make it compatible
with TRIPS Agreement; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and how
Government are planning to protect Indian
interests in WTO?
Financial support to widows and
divorcees from Wakf Board
*280. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court had
directed that Wakf Boards should offer
financial support  to women from minority
community in distress, especially widows
and divorcees;
(b) whether the National Commission
for Women has taken up the matter with
Wakf Boards and the National Commission
for Minorities; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

1745. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND

flow of trade which are proposed to be
addressed?

from a third country are being pushed into

Thailand or Sri Lanka;

SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:

SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
SHRI DARA SINGH:

tickets of the India International Trade Fair,

Promotion Organisation (ITPO);
(b) if so, the details thereof;

Bengal; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?

one hundred twenty-one turmeric related

pleased to state:

and
